environmentVariables.description: OpenAI key for routing (library_ask), synthesis (library_answer, library_research), and embeddings (library_ingest). Search and read tools work without it.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway base URL shared by every LLM role (router, synth, research, embeddings, rerank). Falls back to https://api.openai.com/v1.
environmentVariables.name: ALEXANDRIA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key paired with ALEXANDRIA_BASE_URL. Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: ALEXANDRIA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the core source (CORE, 57M+ open access papers). Free key from core.ac.uk/services/api.
environmentVariables.name: CORE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the courtlistener source (US federal and state court opinions). Free key from courtlistener.com.
environmentVariables.name: COURTLISTENER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks govinfo (Congressional Record, Federal Register, US Code); also accepted by congress and regulations. Free key from api.data.gov.
environmentVariables.name: GOVINFO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the googlebooks source (40M+ books). Free key from the Google Cloud Console (Books API).
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks githubsearch and githubmcp (GitHub code search); optional for ghsa and openiti. Public-repo read scope is enough.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the nasaads source (NASA Astrophysics Data System). Free key from ui.adsabs.harvard.edu.
environmentVariables.name: NASA_ADS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the europeana source (50M+ European cultural heritage items). Free key from apis.europeana.eu.
environmentVariables.name: EUROPEANA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional for semanticscholar and library_recommend; raises the rate limit. Free key from semanticscholar.org/product/api.
environmentVariables.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.environmentVariablesNote: environmentVariables above is a curated subset: the optional, source-specific keys. packageArguments.description: Directory for write approvals, rate-limit counters and the local audit log. Defaults to ~/.rfphub and must be writable — rate limiting fails closed. Pass it where this user has no writable home, and pass the same directory to `rfphub-mcp approve`.
packageArguments.name: --state-dir

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the RFP Hub API. Defaults to https://api.ethrfps.app. The origin of this URL is bound into every write approval.

environmentVariables.description: RFP Hub API credential. Needed ONLY to submit; searching and fetching are anonymous and never send it. Setting it is what registers the write tool at all: without it tools/list returns two tools. A write-scoped key is recommended: its submissions land pending a reviewer's decision.
environmentVariables.name: RFPHUB_API_KEY

server.name: io.github.TheAiSingularity/agentic-research
server.description: Local research agent that verifies its own answers. Runs on Gemma 3 4B + Ollama, $0/query.

environmentVariables.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Default: OpenAI cloud. Use http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for the endpoint above. Use 'ollama' as a sentinel value when running locally against Ollama.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Model identifier used for the synthesize node. Defaults to 'gpt-5-mini'; set to 'gemma3:4b' for Mac-local Ollama.
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_SYNTHESIZER

environmentVariables.description: Model for the plan / classify / critic / compress / verify nodes. Defaults to 'gpt-5-nano'.
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_PLANNER

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model identifier (for retrieval + memory). Default 'text-embedding-3-small'; use 'nomic-embed-text' on Ollama.
environmentVariables.name: EMBED_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SearXNG meta-search instance. Default http://localhost:8888.
environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path to an index directory built via scripts/index_corpus.py. When set, local corpus hits augment web search.
environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_CORPUS_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable the BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 cross-encoder rerank stage. First run downloads ~560MB.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_RERANK

environmentVariables.description: Set to '0' to skip the trafilatura full-page fetch stage. Default '1'.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_FETCH

environmentVariables.description: Your Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Required for the claim extractor, red team, constitution engines, and ECS coherence checks. One v1 tool (generate_trust_card) works without an API key — it's pure assembly + deterministic audit hashing.

environmentVariables.description: Override the Claude model used by the verification engines. Defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6.

environmentVariables.description: Per-engine-call max-tokens cap. Defaults to 2048; raise for verifying long-form content.
environmentVariables.name: GLASSBOX_MAX_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: ECS aggregation mode: arithmetic (weighted mean, default) or geometric (stricter — any zero dimension collapses the total).
environmentVariables.name: GLASSBOX_ECS_MODE
